title: Effects of migration on Australia
log: 2026-11-20T12:15:16Z match: Claude Haiku 5.5 found no bank point the same, so it is written new
2026-11-20T12:25:47Z write: the API refused it in the chapter request, so it is written on its own next

match.reason: The bank card on cultural diversity covers only one of the four effects in the brief, and it does not teach population or workforce growth or housing and service pressure in big cities, so no bank point teaches the same idea.

draft.title: Effects of migration on Australia
card: Migration adds to Australia's population. Many migrants are of working age, so migration also grows the workforce and fills jobs.
Migrants bring languages, foods, faiths and customs from many countries. This adds to Australia's cultural diversity.
Many migrants settle in big cities such as Sydney and Melbourne. More people in a city can put pressure on housing and on services such as transport, schools and hospitals.
Effects can be positive or negative. Planning, such as building more homes and public transport, can help a city cope with growth.
draft.remember: Migration brings more people, workers and cultures, and can strain housing and services in big cities.

a.q: Which effect of migration on Australia is a benefit to the economy?
opts: It grows the workforce and fills jobs
It raises demand for rental housing
It adds crowding to city transport
It puts pressure on school places
a.why: Many migrants are of working age, so they add workers and fill jobs. The other three are pressures that growth in a city's population can create, not benefits.
a.clue: Think about who is able to work.

b.q: Many new migrants settle in Western Sydney. Local councils report that more people are competing for homes and that train services are crowded. What does this show?
opts: Population growth in cities can strain housing and services
Migration lowers the number of workers in Australia
Migration reduces cultural diversity in Australian cities
Migrants cannot be settled in Australian cities
b.why: More people in one area can push up demand for homes and fill transport, which is pressure on housing and services. Migration adds workers and diversity, so the other options reverse its effects.
b.clue: Look at what is crowded and what people are competing for.

a.best: It grows the workforce and fills jobs

b.best: Population growth in cities can strain housing and services
